    col=Counter(colors).most_common(1)[0][0]

        vals=[g[i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)]
        if any(v==bg for v in vals) and sum(v==col for v in vals)>=2: rows.add(i)
    for j in range(c0,c1+1):
        vals=[g[i][j] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
        if any(v==bg for v in vals) and sum(v==col for v in vals)>=2: cols.add(j)
    for i in rows:
        for j in range(c0,c1+1):
            if g[i][j]==col: g[i][j]=2
    for j in cols:
        for i in range(r0,r1+1):
            if g[i][j]==col: g[i][j]=2
    return g
''')

    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # The holes/isolated marks indicate which sections of the thick frame
    # are to be highlighted: fill the interior area bounded by the frame,
    # preserving its original colored pixels.
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg=next(v for v,n in counts.most_common() if v!=bg)
    pts=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==fg]
    r0,r1=min(i for i,j in pts),max(i for i,j in pts)
    c0,c1=min(j for i,j in pts),max(j for i,j in pts)
    # highlight just enclosed interior background with color 2
    for i in range(r0+1,r1):
        for j in range(c0+1,c1):
            if grid[i][j]==bg:
                g[i][j]=2
    return g
''')
